department: Department of Evolution, Ecology and Organismal Biology

deadline.value: Applications are due November 15 (the FAQ page still says December 1, so apply by November 15).
deadline.quote: Applications for admission are due November 15 for programs beginning Autumn semester of the following academic year.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not required (and the GRE is not needed if GPA is 3.0 or above).
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores from the general aptitude (verbal, quantitative, and written) tests are not required from our program applicants.

supervisor.value: Applicants must list an intended faculty advisor; no one is admitted without a designated advisor.
supervisor.quote: Students are not admitted to the EEOB graduate programs without a designated faculty advisor.

funding.value: Most students are paid on teaching or research assistantships or fellowships, with a full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Most of our graduate students are funded by teaching or research assistantships

entry_route.value: A bachelor's is required; a master's is not needed for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree is not required to apply to the Ph.D. program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: MCDB, Molecular Genetics, Microbiology and other biology PhD programs were not researched. The FAQ page gives December 1 while the admissions page gives November 15.
